To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the antibiotic paste is a safe, easy and effective alternative for treating primary molars with pulp exposure.

(i) 38 children were treated with antibiotic pastes in the primary molar teeth; (ii) the antibiotic paste was used in 38 primary molars with a mean follow-up of 3.6 years; (iii) 33 teeth were successfully treated; (iv) the success rate was 86.8% (33/38); and (v) 5 teeth were not treated successfully.

the use of antibiotics in the treatment of primary teeth is not a new concept.
